name: @superschematic/engine
description: An engine that runs a schema with no generated code: it takes schema-file documents as data, versions them, and stores their instances in one SQLite file. Runs on Node.js 24 and Bun. Needs @superschematic/schema-runtime, @superschematic/schema-ir, @superschematic/http-runtime and superscalar next to it in node_modules; see scripts/link-local-deps.mjs. Depends on @superschematic/versiongraph, whose engine and SQLite adapter the core Branches behavior runs. The main entry point imports the HTTP runtime's framework-free entry point for its default permission matcher; the ./http subpath serves an engine over HTTP on the HTTP runtime and Hono, and the ./mcp subpath serves its MCP tools there too on @modelcontextprotocol/server. Hono and the MCP SDK are optional peer dependencies.

scripts.build: node scripts/link-local-deps.mjs && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: bun run build && bun run test:node && bun run test:bun
scripts.test:bun: node scripts/link-local-deps.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && bun test ./test
